Bank English.question: ১) Which one is the correct sentence?
Bank English.option1: ক) The man advanced as if he has killed me.
Bank English.option2: খ) It is high time I do the work.
Bank English.option3: গ) The wind was made blow.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) He did everything except follow my example.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
অপশন a) has killed এর স্থলে had killed হবে।
কারণ, past indefinite + as if/as though + past perfect tense
অপশন b) do এর স্থলে did হবে।
কারণ, It is time/about time/high time + past indefinite tense
অপশন c) made to blow হবে।
কারণ, passive voice made এর পরে infinitive (to + base form) বসে।

Correct Sentence: He did everything except follow my example.

Bank English.question: ২) Choose the correct sentence -
Bank English.option1: ক) The matter was informed to the police
Bank English.option2: খ) The matter has been informed of the police
Bank English.option3: গ) The police was informed of the matter
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The police were informed of the matter
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The Police (সমষ্টি না বুঝিয়ে ব্যক্তিকে বোঝালে) plural + were + v3 + ....
Correct Sentence: The police were informed of the matter.

Bank English.question: ৩) Select the correct sentence -
Bank English.option1: ক) The Jury was unanimous in its decision.
Bank English.option2: খ) The Jury was unanimous in their decision.
Bank English.option3: গ) The Jury were unanimous in the decision.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The Jury were unanimous in its decision.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The Jury (collective noun) এর Possessive adjective হচ্ছে its.
Collective noun সাধারনত singular হয়।
Correct Sentence: The Jury was unanimous in its decision.

Bank English.question: ৪) Choose the correct sentence -
Bank English.option1: ক) Let he and you be witness
Bank English.option2: খ) Let you and him be witnesses
Bank English.option3: গ) Let you and he be witness
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Let him and you be witness
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Let + Pronoun এর Object form [you (2nd) → him (3rd) → I (1st)] + verb .....
Correct Sentence: Let you and him be witnesses.

Bank English.question: ৫) Which of the following sentences is the correct one?
Bank English.option1: ক) My father was in the hospital during six weeks in summer
Bank English.option2: খ) In summer during six weeks my father was in hospital
Bank English.option3: গ) My father was in a hospital during six weeks in summer
Bank English.option4: ঘ) My father was in hospital for six weeks in summer
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
for + Period of time এবং during + the summer .....
Correct Sentence: My father was in hospital for six weeks in summer.

Bank English.question: ৬) Choose the correct sentence -
Bank English.option1: ক) The old car doesn’t need fixed
Bank English.option2: খ) The old car doesn’t need to be fixed
Bank English.option3: গ) The old car doesn’t need a fixing
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The old car needs no fixed
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The old car Subject হওয়ায় sentence টি passive করতে হবে।
কারণ আমরা জানি, যখন বাক্যে কর্মকে প্রাধান্য দেয়া হয় তখন সেটি passive voice হয়।
Correct Sentence: The old car doesn’t need to be fixed.

Bank English.question: ৭) ______ him yet? Now is your chance to do so.
Bank English.option1: ক) Don’t you meet
Bank English.option2: খ) Haven’t you met
Bank English.option3: গ) Hadn’t you met
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Weren’t you meeting
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
yet থাকলে verb এর present perfect tense হয়।
Auxiliary verb (have/has) + subject + principle verb (past participle) + ..... + yet?
Correct Sentence: Haven't you met him yet? Now is your chance to do so.

Bank English.question: ৮) Choose the correct sentence -
Bank English.option1: ক) I will go after a month.
Bank English.option2: খ) He absented from the school
Bank English.option3: গ) One of the passers-by rescued her.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) I could not make justice to it.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
অপশন a) afterএর স্থলে in হবে।

অপশন b) absented এর পরে himself হবে।

অপশন d) make এর স্থলে do হবে।
কারণ, সুবিচার করা অর্থে do justice ব্যবহৃত হয়।

Correct Sentence: One of the passers-by rescued her.

Bank English.question: ৯) The passive form of the sentence ‘A child could not have done this mischief.’ is -
Bank English.option1: ক) This mischief could not have been done by a child
Bank English.option2: খ) This mischief could not been done by a child
Bank English.option3: গ) This mischief could not have be done by a child
Bank English.option4: ঘ) This mischief a child could not have been done
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Subject + {can, could, may, might, will, would, shall, should, must} + have been + v3

Correct Sentence: This mischief could not have been done by a child.

Bank English.question: ১০) The passive form of the sentence ‘I have to do I have to do it.’ is -
Bank English.option1: ক) It has to be done by me
Bank English.option2: খ) It is to be done by me
Bank English.option3: গ) It has to be done to me
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Let it be done by me
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
am/is/are/were + to এবং Have/has/had/shall have/will have + to, be going to এদের Passive Structure হচ্ছে -

Subject + {am/is/are/were + to ....Have/has/had/shall have/will have + to be going} + be + v3 + ........
Correct Sentence: It has to be done by me.

Bank English.question: ১১) The passive form of the sentence ‘Who gave you this pen?’ is-
Bank English.option1: ক) By whom were you got this pen?
Bank English.option2: খ) By whom were you given this pen?
Bank English.option3: গ) By whom have you been given this pen?
Bank English.option4: ঘ) By whom was you given this pen?
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Active form: Who + aux. + verb + object.
Passive form: By whom + aux.[Tense অনুযায়ী] + subject (object থেকে প্রাপ্ত) + v.p.p?

Correct Sentence: By whom were you given this pen?

Bank English.question: ১২) What is the passive form of the following sentence? ‘Please enter by the other door’ -
Bank English.option1: ক) You must enter by the other door.
Bank English.option2: খ) You should enter by the other door.
Bank English.option3: গ) You are requested to enter by the other door.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) You are asked to enter by the other door.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Passive বাক্যে You are to + verb সহ বাকী অংশ
অথবা Object কে Subject + may + please/kindly + be + v3 + (to/for/by) + sub. কে object
দুটো object থাকলে যেকোনটিকে subject বানানো যাবে।

Correct Sentence: You are requested to enter by the other door.

Bank English.question: ১৩) The passive form of the sentence ‘We cannot achieve success without hard work.’ -
Bank English.option1: ক) Success cannot be achieved without hard work.
Bank English.option2: খ) Success cannot have been achieved without hard work.
Bank English.option3: গ) Success cannot have been achieved by us without hard work.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Success cannot achieve without hard work.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The active verb 'cannot achieve' becomes 'cannot be achieved' in the passive voice.
The agent (the person who performs the action) can be omitted in the passive voice.

Correct Sentence: Success cannot be achieved without hard work.

Bank English.question: ১৪) The active form of the sentence ‘The visitors were shown a collection of old manuscripts.’ -
Bank English.option1: ক) A collection of old manuscripts was shown to the visitors.
Bank English.option2: খ) The hostess was showing the visitors a collection of old manuscripts.
Bank English.option3: গ) The hostess showed the visitors a collection of old manuscripts.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The hostess was showed a collection of old manuscripts.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The passive verb 'were/was shown' becomes 'showed' in the active voice.
When the agent (the person who performs the action) is not mentioned in the passive voice, we can use a noun/pronoun appropriate for the context in the active voice.

Correct Sentence: The hostess showed the visitors a collection of old manuscripts.

Bank English.question: ১৫) The passive form of the sentence ‘I have already shown the Officer Jakir’s photo.’ -
Bank English.option1: ক) The officer had already been shown Jakir’s photo.
Bank English.option2: খ) Jakir’s photo has already been shown to the Officer.
Bank English.option3: গ) Jakir’s photo had already been shown to the Officer.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The officer has already been showing Jakir’s photo.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
When the active verb has two objects, there are two possibilities.
a) The direct object (usually a thing) can be the subject of the passive verb.
b) The indirect object (usually a person) can be the subject of the passive verb.
In the given sentence, the direct object is the phrase `Jakir`s photo` and the indirect object is the noun `the Officer`.
When the direct object becomes the subject of the passive verb, we get: Jakir`s photo has already been shown to the Officer.
When the indirect object is the subject of the passive verb, we get: The officer has already been shown Jakir`s photo.

Correct Sentence: Jakir’s photo has already been shown to the Officer.

Bank English.question: ১৬) Choose the correct passive voice of ‘BBC broadcast the breaking news’ -
Bank English.option1: ক) The breaking news is broadcasted by BBC.
Bank English.option2: খ) The breaking news were broadcasted by BBC.
Bank English.option3: গ) The breaking news was broadcasted by BBC.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The breaking news are broadcasted by BBC.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
সাহায্যকারী Verb বিহীন Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর। [V3 = past participle]
Active: Subject (Agent - কাজ সম্পাদনকারী) + verb + Object.
এক্ষেত্রে verb এর পূর্বে do/does/did + not অথবা, পরে e/es/ed অথবা অনিয়মিত V2 থাকে।
Passive: Object টি Subject হয় + (am/is/are/was/were) + V3 + by + Subject টি Object হয়।

প্রদত্ত প্রশ্নে Sentence টি past indefinite tense এ আছে এবং news সর্বদাই singular হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয় বিধায় এর পরে auxiliary verb হিসেবে was বসবে।
দ্বিতীয়ত, broadcast এর Vpp/V3 হচ্ছে broadcast.

Correct Sentence: The breaking news was broadcasted by BBC.

Bank English.question: ১৭) Choose the correct passive voice of ‘I had written the letter’. -
Bank English.option1: ক) The letter had been written by me.
Bank English.option2: খ) The letter was written by me.
Bank English.option3: গ) The letter was being written by me.
Bank English.option4: ঘ) The letter was wrote by me.
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Have/Has/Had + V3 যুক্ত Active voice কে Passive voice এ রূপান্তর।
Active: Subject + have/has/had + V3 + Object.
Passive: Object টি Subject হয় + have/has/had + been + V3 + by + Subject টি Object হয়।
N.B. Active voice টি Present perfect হলে have/has এবং past perfect হলে had বসে।

Correct Sentence: The letter had been written by me.

Bank English.question: ১৮) The area <u>where</u> a <u>microchip</u> is manufactured must be the <u>most</u> <u>cleanest</u>. Identify the incorrect underline word/phrase?
Bank English.option1: ক) where
Bank English.option2: খ) microchip
Bank English.option3: গ) most
Bank English.option4: ঘ) cleanest
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Cleanest হচ্ছে clean এর superlative form তাই cleanest এর পূর্বে most এর ব্যবহার অপ্রয়োজনীয়।
কারণ, বাক্যে সাধারণত একসাথে double superlative বা comrative double এর ব্যবহার নিয়মসিদ্ধ নয়।

Correct Sentence: The area where a microchip is manufactured must be the cleanest.

Bank English.question: ১৯) <u>As soon</u> as the sun <u>had risen</u> over the mountains, it became <u>unbearable</u> <u>hot</u> in the plain land. Identify the incorrect underlined word/phrase?
Bank English.option1: ক) as soon
Bank English.option2: খ) had risen
Bank English.option3: গ) unbearable
Bank English.option4: ঘ) hot
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
unbearably (adv.) হবে।
কারণ, linking verb এর পরে adverb বসে।
linking verb গুলো হচ্ছে to be, become, look, feel, smell, taste, seem, remain, appear, run, go, grow, read, turn ইত্যাদি।

Correct Sentence: As soon as the sun had risen over the mountains, it became unbearably hot in the plain land.

Bank English.question: ২০) The advantages of computerized <u>typing</u> and <u>editing</u> are now being <u>extending</u> to all the written <u>languages</u> of the world. Identify the incorrect underline word/phrase?
Bank English.option1: ক) typing
Bank English.option2: খ) editing
Bank English.option3: গ) extending
Bank English.option4: ঘ) languages
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
extending এর স্থলে extended হবে।
কারণ, being এর পরে verb এর past participle form বসে।

Correct Sentence: The advantages of computerized typing and editing are now being extended to all the written languages of the world.

Bank English.question: ২১) The <u>price of</u> crude oil used to be a <u>great</u> deal <u>lower</u> than now, <u>wasn’t it</u>? Identify the incorrect underline word/phrase?
Bank English.option1: ক) price of
Bank English.option2: খ) great
Bank English.option3: গ) lower
Bank English.option4: ঘ) wasn’t it
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
wasn't এর স্থলে didn't হবে।
কারণ, শুধু used to এর tag question এ didn't/usedn't বসে।

Correct Sentence: The price of crude oil used to be a great deal lower than now, didn’t it?

Bank English.question: ২২) After <u>rising</u> the flag <u>to commemorate the holiday</u>, the mayor <u>gave a long speech</u>. Identify the incorrect underlined word/phrase?
Bank English.option1: ক) rising
Bank English.option2: খ) To commemorate
Bank English.option3: গ) The holiday
Bank English.option4: ঘ) gave a long speech
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
rising এর স্থলে raising হবে।
কারণ, raise-কিছু উত্তোলন করা বা উঠানো; rise - নিজে উঠা বা বৃদ্ধি পাওয়া।
rise + preposition/adverb/no word (বাক্যের শেষে) ; raise + object (noun/pronoun)

Correct Sentence: After raising the flag to commemorate the holiday, the mayor gave a long speech.

Bank English.question: ২৩) The Principal was considering <u>to postponing</u> the examination <u>until</u> the following month <u>because of</u> the students’ demonstrations. Identify the incorrect underline word/phrase.
Bank English.option1: ক) was considering
Bank English.option2: খ) to postponing
Bank English.option3: গ) until
Bank English.option4: ঘ) because of
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
to postponding এর স্থলে শুধু postponding হবে।
কারণ, consider এর পরে gerund (verb + ing) বসে।

Correct Sentence: The Principal was considering postponing the examination until the following month because of the students’ demonstrations.

লাইভ পরীক্ষায় প্রশ্নের লেখায় কিছুটা সমস্যা ছিল। তাই, উত্তর তুলে দেয়া হল।

Bank English.question: ২৪) Democracies generally elect their leaders by _____ . Fill in the gap with appropriate words.
Bank English.option1: ক) Polling
Bank English.option2: খ) Campaigning
Bank English.option3: গ) Deeds
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Qualification

Explanation:
polling refers to the process of voting in an election.

Correct Sentence: Democracies generally elect their leaders by polling.
অর্থঃ গণতন্ত্রগুলিতে সাধারণত ভোট দিয়ে তাদের নেতাদের নির্বাচন করে।

Bank English.question: ২৫) ______ packets of a popular shampoo are being distributed free to people in this apartment as a part of advertisement/promotion exercise. Fill in the gap with appropriate words.
Bank English.option1: ক) Large
Bank English.option2: খ) Sample
Bank English.option3: গ) Fortified
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Extra
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Though Large, Fortified (strengthened by some ingredient), Extra seems correct by meaning, but 'Sample' fits the blank well. Usually, many companies distribute sample packets (in small quantities) as part of advertisements/promotions.

Correct Sentence: Sample packets of a popular shampoo are being distributed free to people in this apartment as a part of the advertisement/promotion exercise.
অর্থঃ বিজ্ঞাপন/প্রচার অনুশীলনের অংশ হিসাবে একটি জনপ্রিয় শ্যাম্পুর নমুনা প্যাকেটগুলি এই অ্যাপার্টমেন্টে লোকেদের মধ্যে বিনামূল্যে বিতরণ করা হচ্ছে।

Bank English.question: ২৬) Wounds go away but deep _____ may turn permanent. Fill in the gap with appropriate words.
Bank English.option1: ক) Worries
Bank English.option2: খ) Pain
Bank English.option3: গ) Cuts
Bank English.option4: ঘ) Scars
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
Worries, Pain, and Cuts often heal with time while deep scars can be permanent.
Some may argue that worries and pain may not go away in some cases.
But looking at the context of the sentence we can see that it starts with a reference to 'Wounds'.
Hence adding scars to the next half of the sentence seems appropriate

Correct Sentence: Wounds go away but deep scars may turn permanent.
অর্থঃ ক্ষতগুলি চলে যায় তবে গভীর দাগগুলি স্থায়ী হয়ে যেতে পারে।

Bank English.question: ২৭) Most of the issues discussed here in the meeting were trivial and only a few were ____.
Bank English.option1: ক) interesting
Bank English.option2: খ) significant
Bank English.option3: গ) practical
Bank English.option4: ঘ) irrelevant
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
প্রশ্নের বাক্য থেকে বোঝা যায় বেশিরভাগ ছিল trivial = সামান্য; তুচ্ছ; অকিঞ্চিৎকর; নগণ্য।
তাহলে বাকিগুলো ছিল এর উলটো মানে important বা significant.
Significant = বিশেষ অর্থপূর্ণ; বিশেষ ইঙ্গিতপূর্ণ; গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।
The antonym of Trivial:
Important, Significant, Life-and-death.

Correct Sentence: Most of the issues discussed here in the meeting were trivial and only a few were significant.
অর্থঃ মিটিং এ আলোচিত বিষয়গুলোর বেশিরভাগ ছিল গুরুত্বহীন এবং কেবল কয়েকটি বিষয় ছিল গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

Bank English.question: ২৮) Questions will be answered by a ____ of experts. Fill in the gap with appropriate words.
Bank English.option1: ক) panel
Bank English.option2: খ) staff
Bank English.option3: গ) bunch
Bank English.option4: ঘ) band
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The Bengali meaning of the following words:
panel = শ্রোতাদের উপস্থিতি ও অংশগ্রহণের মাধ্যমে কোনো আলোচনার জন্য নির্বাচিত বক্তাবৃন্দ।
staff = কোনো প্রতিষ্ঠানের কর্মচারীবৃন্দ।
bunch = জনতা; দল।
band = একত্রে বাজনা বাজায় এমন ব্যক্তিদের সমষ্টি; বাদকদল।
Though staff, bunch, band seems correct by meaning, but 'Panel' fits the blank well.

Correct Sentence: Questions will be answered by a panel of experts.
অর্থঃ একদল বিশেষজ্ঞের দ্বারা প্রশ্নগুলোর উত্তর দেওয়া যাবে।

Bank English.question: ২৯) Let us not be too ____ about the outcome; something could go wrong.
Bank English.option1: ক) serene
Bank English.option2: খ) sanguine
Bank English.option3: গ) scrupulous
Bank English.option4: ঘ) scuttle
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The Bengali meaning of the following words:
serene = স্বচ্ছ ও শান্ত; স্থির; শান্তিপূর্ণ; প্রশান্ত; নির্মেঘ; নির্মল।
sanguine = আশাবাদী।
scrupulous = নৈতিক কোনো অন্যায় না-করার বিষয়ে সতর্ক; বিবেকবান; বিবেকদর্শী; খুঁতখুঁতে।
scuttle = তড়িঘড়ি করে পালানো।
'Sanguine' fits the blank well.

Correct Sentence: Let us not be too sanguine about the outcome; something could go wrong.
অর্থঃ আমাদের খুব বেশি আশাবাদী না হওয়াই ভাল, খারাপ কিছু একটা ঘটেও যেতে পারে।।

Bank English.question: ৩০) He is always so _______ that he doubts everybody and double checks all that is told to him. Fill in the gap with appropriate words.
Bank English.option1: ক) Gullible
Bank English.option2: খ) naive
Bank English.option3: গ) convinced
Bank English.option4: ঘ) skeptical
Bank English.exp:
Explanation:
The Bengali meaning of the following words:
gullible = সহজে প্রতারণাযোগ্য।
naive = কৌতুকজনকভাবে সরল; কাঁচা।
convinced = প্রমাণ, যুক্তি ইত্যাদির সাহায্যে দৃঢ় প্রত্যয় উৎপাদন করা; কাউকে বোঝানো।
skeptical = সন্দেহপ্রবণ; সংশয়বাদী; সন্দিগ্ধচিত্ত।
'Skeptical' fits the blank well.

Correct Sentence: He is always so skeptical that he doubts everybody and double checks all that is told to him.
অর্থঃ সে সর্বদা এতোটাই সন্দেহপ্রবণ থাকে যে, সে সবাইকে সন্দেহ করে এবং তাকে যা কিছুই বলা হোক না কেন, দুইবার করে যাচাই করে নেয়।
